pages.title: Bubble Universe
pages.text: A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different. It floats in place and is faintly warm, like a tiny sun behind fog.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Eternal inflation predicts bubbles of other universes forming endlessly. I caught one at the moment it nucleated and found it would sit still in our world without expanding into it.
